_model: play-and-park. The clip plays cue to cue at --df-rate (1.2x since Sept 2 2026; 1.0x before) and stops on a cue, where that section's reveal fires. Going back up is a cut to the cue. BOUNDARIES DO NOT DRIVE THE VIDEO under this model - they are scroll landings only, kept here for provenance. cueFrame is the authoritative number.
_moves: Sept 2 2026, owner's call: EVERY LEG THE SAME LENGTH. Cues re-spaced on a 41-frame grid across the whole clip with Music pinned at 83 (the artwork match that brings the reactive background in): About 21 -> 41, Music 83, Merch 153 -> 124, Transmissions 216 -> 165, Archive 252 -> 206, Stay Connected 272 -> 247, Foot 288. Legs are 41/42/41/41/41/41/41 frames = 1.42-1.46s at 1.2x; before they ran 21/62/70/63/36/20/16, which read as a quick opening and a steppy 0.42x tail. Costs, accepted: About leaves the flattest horizon (f41 is the same horizon a little later), Merch parks on the flash's rise (f124, lum 0.7) instead of its peak (f153), Archive leaves the last structural event. The startFrame/endFrame boundaries below were NOT moved - they never drove the clip.
About cue 25 -> 21: flattest horizon in the clip (edge-row spread 0.8px vs 2.4px at f25, rank 1 of 289).
Music cue 82 -> 83: measured best structural match to starfield-deep-4k.webp, r=0.907 (the old clip's best was f134 at r=0.720).
Archive cue 272 -> 252: f252 is the clip's last measured structural event; f272 was unanchored.
Stay Connected cue 287 -> 272: tail rebalance, so no leg is shorter than 0.66s (was 0.083s).

Merch cue 157 -> 153: owner's call Aug 18 2026. f153 is the clip's luminance peak (84.7 against a 1.2 floor), the top of the whiteout one frame before the light dies (f154 56.3, f156 16.2). Merch now parks ON the flash rather than after it.
